name: week
title: Charter dispatch review
subtitle: Recorded dates are UTC. Confirm local departure times, duty fitness and route buffers.

sections.title: Confirmed movements
sections.sql: select code,booking,customer,starts_at,ends_at,pickup,destination,passengers,vehicle,driver,readiness from dispatch_diary where status='confirmed' and ends_at>=now() order by starts_at

sections.title: Quotes to follow up
sections.sql: select code,customer,quote_due,last_contact from quote_followups order by quote_due

sections.title: Contract reviews
sections.sql: select code,name,customer,ends_on,review_on from contract_review where review_on<=current_date+30

name: balances
title: Charter balances
subtitle: Recorded balances only. Reconcile to your accounting ledger.

sections.title: Amounts outstanding
sections.sql: select code,customer,booking,currency,due_on,balance_cents from debtors order by due_on

name: evidence
title: Driver and vehicle evidence
subtitle: Record checks, not dispatch clearance or an approved electronic logbook.

sections.title: Recorded cumulative days
sections.sql: select driver,country,cumulative_day,work_minutes,evidence_recorded from duty_totals order by cumulative_day desc
